text: まける　なんて…　まだ　ポケモン　そだって　ないのか　なあ

structure.jp: まだ　ポケモン　そだって　ないのか　なあ
structure.en: I wonder if my Pokémon still haven't grown

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after an action shows surprise or dismay at it. まける なんて = 'to think I'd lose'.

patterns.name: 〜のかな
patterns.span: そだって　ないのか　なあ
patterns.explanation: のか なあ at the end means 'I wonder if it is that...', as you look for the reason. そだって ないのか なあ = 'I wonder if it's that they haven't grown'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: そだっていない, shortened here, says the state of having grown has not been reached, and with まだ means 'not yet'. そだって ない = 'haven't grown up yet'.
